args.command:
cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import random
random.seed(42)
chars = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_ -.:|!'
words = []
for _ in range(400):
    n = random.randint(1, 15)
    words.append(''.join(random.choice(chars) for _ in range(n)))
# targeted suffix soup around the singular rules
import itertools
suffs = ['ies','ves','ice','a','es','s','is','us','um','en','xi','zes','en','ices','ouses']
pre = ['', 'x','a','qu','f','l','r','m','|','t','i','bus','ox','oxen','quiz','matr','vert','ind','cris','ax','test','alias','status','octop','vir','hive','tive','shoe','series','movies','news','analy','the','ba','diagno','parenthe','progno','synop','nn']
for p in pre:
    for s in suffs:
        words.append(p+s)
print('\n'.join(words))
" > fuzz.txt
fail=0; count=0
while IFS= read -r w; do
  count=$((count+1))
  ref=$(/workspace/dataset/test20_executable "$w" 2>/dev/null); refc=$?
  mine=$(/output/test20 "$w" 2>/dev/null); minec=$?
  if [ "$ref" != "$mine" ] || [ "$refc" != "$minec" ]; then fail=1; echo "MISMATCH [$w] (rc $refc vs $minec)"; diff <(echo "$ref") <(echo "$mine") | head -6; fi
done < fuzz.txt
echo "checked=$count fail=$fail"
